latestLocalWork.a2aQuoteOnlyRequest: Authenticated POST /api/sky/a2a-price-quotes loads an owner-connected Agent, enforces the operator egress allowlist and per-owner request limits, refuses to send the prompt until an active Provider usage key exists for that exact origin, and verifies the returned signed quote against the exact request. Before egress, migration 0049 now stores an append-only, owner/request-bound consent event with Agent/card identity, prompt SHA-256, currency, budget cap, expiry and disclosure-policy version; it does not store prompt text. Same-ID retries never call the Provider again. The event is local source only; synthetic SQLite tests cover immutability, owner separation, changed-term conflicts and replay refusal. No Provider extension is accepted.
latestLocalWork.androidA2AQuoteReview: Shell API v12 and main Shell UI now list owner-connected Sky Agents and request quote-only pricing after separate prompt-disclosure consent. Broker verifies the Provider signature and binds the returned quote to the selected Agent origin/name/version, exact prompt hash, currency, maximum cap, and expiry using the operator-provisioned trust inventory before the UI renders itemized usage. Quote response must remain quoteOnly=true and executionAuthorized=false; this path creates no delegation, Wallet hold, Broker execution proof, or Cloud task. Source contracts pass; Android runtime and real Provider remain unverified.
latestLocalWork.androidSameJobRecovery: The task-detail readback now requires an exact Cloud-to-native Wallet binding. Android-independent Core recomputes the native v2 reservation payload digest from the authenticated Cloud terms and compares owner, IDs, agent, currency, pricing version, cap, issue time, deadline and recoverable Wallet state. Mismatch remains unknown/held and cannot resubmit. Seven JUnit cases are authored, not executed without a JDK/Gradle/Android SDK.
latestLocalWork.webToolRunnerCodeSplit: Shared MrToolRunner now dynamically imports the five specialized runners and renders a semantic loading output; unrelated tool journeys no longer statically include legal, patent, delivery, subscription-ledger and Jev runner code. In the latest build, the mr-tool-runner chunk fell from 662,710 bytes to 91,268 bytes, while the specialized legal runner is a separate 40,560-byte chunk. Build, typecheck, product lint, bundle inventory, web asset closure (135 references, 0 missing) and focused UI/runner tests 33/33 passed. This does not remove the separate >500kB chunks or shared sky-commerce CSS output collision warning.
latestLocalWork.purchaseClaimReplayProtection: New migration 0050 adds a unique index on issuer plus purchase-reference SHA-256. Local tests prove exact same-package same-owner redemption remains idempotent, a different claim ID for an already-consumed purchase is rejected, and two concurrent different claims for the same purchase result in exactly one account binding. Signed cancellation tombstones can now be recorded before redemption, block the delayed old claim, and permit a seller-issued replacement claim for the same purchase hash. Same migration bytes and fresh/release/sites filename/Drizzle histories converge. This is source/local-D1 evidence only; no production preflight/deploy or seller registry/webhook integration is accepted.
